sources.summary: ‘We were swept up in the moment and full of testosterone. The 90s wasn’t a time when men were encouraged to be sensitive’ We were hanging out with the lovely producer George Drakoulias at Abbey Road. He said, “We’re going to bring in some instruments for you guys” – and replaced the fairly low-budget ones we’d been playing. I was given this beautiful 1960s Fender Jazz bass. Continue reading...
